lines: In twelve-named in twelve cakra with-half hundred would be; rising that indeed with four-forty-hundred would be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dvādaśākhye dvādaśite cakre sārdhaṃ śataṃ bhavet udayastaddhi sacatuścatvāriṃśacchataṃ bhavet
